# Batch 3A — the fat and driven set: 01 Red Pill, 02 Cement Grind, 06 zzuFuzz, 08 Wire Bite

*Generated by `tests/voicing/batch03a.py --index`. Each folder: `A` original (through the base program path), `B` centre (the recommended variant and the committed patch), `C`, `D` along the axes named below. WAV names: `<variant>_<tag>_<phrase>.wav`, phrases riff / stabs / held (the pilot phrases) and the patch's own (spit = i, grind = j, wall = k, wire = l). The WAVs are on the `listen/batch-03a-chapter1-fat-and-driven` branch only; the full tables (`README.md`, `numbers.md`, `results.json`) are in each folder and on the voicing branch. Level: matched to -18.0 dBFS RMS (README section 12 says on what).*

## 02 Cement Grind — level read on: RMS over the note-on region of the grind riff (phrase j)
